simple.meaning: מָא (mâʼ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “(as indefinitely) that.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 1 Kings 22:21. The surrounding context includes kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָא (H3964) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מָא (mâʼ) / H3964 is traced through 1 Kings 22:21, Ezra 6:8 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H3964. ma מָה ( מָא Ezra 6:8 ) pronoun interrogative and indefinite what? (Biblical Hebrew מָה ; Nabataean מה ; Zinjirli מ ; מא ᵑ7 ; Syriac ; Arabic : compare W CG 124 f. ); — 1 what ? Dan 4:32 עבדת מה . 2 whatever, what (compare Biblical Hebrew 1b end) Dan 2:22 בחשׁוכא מח ידע knoweth what is in darkness, Ezra 6:9 : so דִּי מָה (compare דִּי 1b: so Nabataean; Palmyrene מדי די, מא , Lzb 306 Cooke 320, 332 ) Dan 2:28-29 , (twice in verse); 2:45 ; Ezra 6:8 תעבדון די למא with regard to what ye shall do, 7:18 (= whatsoever ). 3 with prefixes: a. כְּמָה how! Daniel 3:33 (twice in verse). b. לְמָה why? (compare Biblical Hebrew לָמָּה ) Ezra 4:22 be not slack herein: why should damage grow, etc., virtually = lest damage grow ( ᵐ5 μή ποτε ), 7:23 קצף להוא למה די for why should there be wrath ? = lest [ ᵐ5 μή ποτε ] there be wrath (compare דִּילְמָא ᵑ7 , Syriac lest: and see מָה 4d b , p. 554:a). c. עלמֿה wherefore ? Dan 2:15 .

occurrences.englishText: A spirit came out and stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’

Moreover I make a decree what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the River, expenses must be given with all diligence to these men, that they not be hindered.
